<script>
function handleTurtlewatchData(data) {
  console.log("TurtleWatch JSONP data:", data);

  const columnNames = data?.table?.columnNames || [];
  const rows = data?.table?.rows || [];

  const parsedRows = rows.map(rowArray => {
    const row = {};
    columnNames.forEach((col, i) => {
      row[col] = rowArray[i];
    });
    return row;
  });

  console.log("Parsed row count:", parsedRows.length);
  console.log("First parsed row:", parsedRows[0]);

  function isFilled(value) {
    return value !== undefined &&
           value !== null &&
           String(value).trim() !== "" &&
           String(value).trim().toLowerCase() !== "nan";
  }

  function getSortableDate(row) {
    const candidates = [
      row.time,
      row.month_date,
      row.map_date_iso,
      row.enso_date_iso
    ];

    for (const value of candidates) {
      if (!isFilled(value)) continue;
      const d = new Date(value);
      if (!isNaN(d)) return d.getTime();
    }

    return -Infinity;
  }

  function getLatestRowWith(rows, fields) {
    const filtered = rows.filter(row =>
      fields.every(field => isFilled(row[field]))
    );

    if (filtered.length === 0) return null;

    filtered.sort((a, b) => getSortableDate(b) - getSortableDate(a));
    return filtered[0];
  }

  // ENSO
  const ensoRow = getLatestRowWith(parsedRows, [
    "enso_date_print",
    "enso_synopsis",
    "enso_status"
  ]);

  console.log("ENSO row:", ensoRow);

  if (ensoRow) {
    const ninoStatus = document.getElementById("nino-status");
    const ninoDate = document.getElementById("nino-date");
    const ninoSynopsis = document.getElementById("nino-synopsis");
    const ninoLink = document.getElementById("nino-link");

    if (ninoStatus) ninoStatus.textContent = ensoRow.enso_status || "Not available";
    if (ninoDate) ninoDate.textContent = ensoRow.enso_date_print || "Not available";
    if (ninoSynopsis) ninoSynopsis.textContent = (ensoRow.enso_synopsis || "").trim() || "Not available";
    if (ninoLink && isFilled(ensoRow.enso_source_url)) {
      ninoLink.href = ensoRow.enso_source_url;
    }
  }

  // Heatwave
  const heatwaveRow = getLatestRowWith(parsedRows, [
    "heatwave_heat_date",
    "heatwave_heat_period",
    "heatwave_north_pacific",
    "heatwave_tropical_pacific"
  ]);

  console.log("Heatwave row:", heatwaveRow);

  if (heatwaveRow) {
    const hwPeriod = document.getElementById("heat-period");
    const hwDate = document.getElementById("heat-date");
    const hwLink = document.getElementById("heat-link");
    const npEl = document.getElementById("heat-np");
    const tpEl = document.getElementById("heat-tp");

    if (hwPeriod) hwPeriod.textContent = heatwaveRow.heatwave_heat_period || "Not available";
    if (hwDate) hwDate.textContent = heatwaveRow.heatwave_heat_date || "Not available";
    if (hwLink && isFilled(heatwaveRow.heatwave_source_url)) {
      hwLink.href = heatwaveRow.heatwave_source_url;
    }
    if (npEl) npEl.textContent = (heatwaveRow.heatwave_north_pacific || "").trim() || "Not available";
    if (tpEl) tpEl.textContent = (heatwaveRow.heatwave_tropical_pacific || "").trim() || "Not available";
  }

  // TOTAL status
  const totalRow = getLatestRowWith(parsedRows, [
    "status_alert",
    "status_fc_date",
    "status_update_date",
    "status_new_index"
  ]);

  console.log("TOTAL row:", totalRow);

  if (totalRow) {
    const fcEl = document.getElementById("total-fcdate");
    const stEl = document.getElementById("total-status");
    const idxEl = document.getElementById("total-index");
    const updEl = document.getElementById("total-updated");

    if (fcEl) fcEl.textContent = totalRow.status_fc_date || "Not available";
    if (stEl) stEl.textContent = totalRow.status_alert || "Not available";
    if (idxEl) idxEl.textContent = totalRow.status_new_index || "Not available";
    function formatDatePretty(dateStr) {
      if (!dateStr) return "Not available";

      const d = new Date(dateStr);
      if (isNaN(d)) return dateStr;

      return d.toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
        day: "2-digit",
        month: "short",
        year: "numeric"
      });
    }

    updEl.textContent = formatDatePretty(totalRow.status_update_date);
  }

  // SST / anomaly summary table
  const container = document.getElementById("sst-table-container");
  if (container) {
    let mapRows = parsedRows
      .filter(r =>
        isFilled(r.map_month) &&
        isFilled(r.map_sst) &&
        isFilled(r.map_anom)
      )
      .sort((a, b) => {
        const aVal = String(a.map_date_ym || a.time || "");
        const bVal = String(b.map_date_ym || b.time || "");
        return aVal.localeCompare(bVal);
      });

    mapRows = mapRows.slice(-6);
    console.log("Map rows:", mapRows);

    const months = mapRows.map(r => r.map_month || "");
    const sstVals = mapRows.map(r => parseFloat(r.map_sst));
    const anomVals = mapRows.map(r => parseFloat(r.map_anom));

    const table = document.createElement("table");
    table.className = "table table-condensed table-striped";

    const thead = document.createElement("thead");
    const headerRow = document.createElement("tr");
    headerRow.appendChild(document.createElement("th"));

    months.forEach(m => {
      const th = document.createElement("th");
      th.textContent = m;
      headerRow.appendChild(th);
    });

    thead.appendChild(headerRow);
    table.appendChild(thead);

    const tbody = document.createElement("tbody");

    const tempRow = document.createElement("tr");
    const tempLabel = document.createElement("td");
    tempLabel.textContent = "Temperature";
    tempRow.appendChild(tempLabel);

    sstVals.forEach(v => {
      const td = document.createElement("td");
      td.textContent = Number.isFinite(v) ? v.toFixed(1) : "NA";
      tempRow.appendChild(td);
    });
    tbody.appendChild(tempRow);

    const anomRow = document.createElement("tr");
    const anomLabel = document.createElement("td");
    anomLabel.textContent = "Anomaly";
    anomRow.appendChild(anomLabel);

    anomVals.forEach(v => {
      const td = document.createElement("td");
      td.textContent = Number.isFinite(v) ? v.toFixed(1) : "NA";
      td.style.fontWeight = "bold";
      td.style.color = v > 0 ? "red" : v < 0 ? "blue" : "black";
      anomRow.appendChild(td);
    });
    tbody.appendChild(anomRow);

    table.appendChild(tbody);
    container.innerHTML = "";
    container.appendChild(table);

    const radios = document.querySelectorAll("input[name='temp-unit']");
    radios.forEach(radio => {
      radio.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const temps = table.querySelectorAll("tbody tr:first-child td:not(:first-child)");
        const anoms = table.querySelectorAll("tbody tr:last-child td:not(:first-child)");

        temps.forEach((td, i) => {
          const c = sstVals[i];
          td.textContent = !Number.isFinite(c)
            ? "NA"
            : radio.value === "C"
            ? c.toFixed(1)
            : (c * 9 / 5 + 32).toFixed(1);
        });

        anoms.forEach((td, i) => {
          const c = anomVals[i];
          td.textContent = !Number.isFinite(c)
            ? "NA"
            : radio.value === "C"
            ? c.toFixed(1)
            : (c * 9 / 5).toFixed(1);
        });
      });
    });
  }
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", async () => {

  // Closure CSV logic
  fetch("data/resources/ltca_closure.csv")
    .then(response => response.text())
    .then(text => {
      const rows = text.trim().split("\n").map(r => r.split(","));
      const headers = rows.shift().map(h => h.trim());
      const startIdx = headers.findIndex(h => /start/i.test(h));
      const endIdx = headers.findIndex(h => /end/i.test(h));

      if (startIdx === -1 || endIdx === -1) {
        console.error("Start or End column not found in closure CSV");
        return;
      }

      const parsed = rows
        .map(r => ({
          start: new Date(r[startIdx]),
          end: new Date(r[endIdx]),
        }))
        .filter(d => !isNaN(d.start) && !isNaN(d.end))
        .sort((a, b) => b.end - a.end);

      const recent = parsed[0];
      if (!recent) return;

      const now = new Date();
      const banner = document.querySelector(".status-banner");
      const textEl = document.querySelector(".status-text");
      const dateEl = document.querySelector(".status-date");

      banner.classList.remove("alert-active", "alert-upcoming");
      banner.classList.add("success");
      textEl.textContent = "No closure in effect";

      if (now < recent.start) {
        banner.classList.remove("success");
        banner.classList.add("alert-upcoming");
        textEl.textContent = "Closure Alert: Will take effect soon";
      } else if (now >= recent.start && now <= recent.end) {
        banner.classList.remove("success");
        banner.classList.add("alert-active");
        textEl.textContent = "Closure is in effect";
      }

      if (dateEl) {
        const opts = { year: "numeric", month: "long", day: "numeric" };
        dateEl.textContent = "Updated " + now.toLocaleDateString(undefined, opts);
      }
    })
    .catch(err => console.error("Error loading closure CSV:", err));

  // Load TurtleWatch table via JSONP
  const old = document.getElementById("turtlewatch-jsonp-script");
  if (old) old.remove();

  const s = document.createElement("script");
  s.id = "turtlewatch-jsonp-script";
  s.src =
    "http://localhost:8080/erddap/tabledap/turtlewatch_master_table.json?" +
    [
      "time",
      "month_date",
      "indicator_date16",
      "indicator_date01",
      "indicator_anom",
      "indicator_value",
      "indicator_count",
      "indicator_stdev",
      "map_date_ym",
      "map_date_iso",
      "map_month",
      "map_sst",
      "map_anom",
      "enso_date_yrmo",
      "enso_date_iso",
      "enso_date_print",
      "enso_synopsis",
      "enso_status",
      "enso_source_url",
      "heatwave_heat_status",
      "heatwave_heat_date",
      "heatwave_heat_period",
      "heatwave_north_pacific",
      "heatwave_tropical_pacific",
      "heatwave_source_url",
      "status_alert",
      "status_fc_date",
      "status_update_date",
      "status_new_index"
    ].join(",") +
    "&.jsonp=handleTurtlewatchData";

  document.body.appendChild(s);

  // -----------------------------
  // Image slider logic with fallback
  // -----------------------------
  const sstImgEl = document.getElementById("sst-dash-image");
  const sstPrevBtn = document.querySelector(".sst-slider .prev");
  const sstNextBtn = document.querySelector(".sst-slider .next");
  const sstYearLabels = document.querySelectorAll("#sst-year");

  const anomImgEl = document.getElementById("anom-image");
  const anomPrevBtn = document.querySelector(".anom-slider .prev");
  const anomNextBtn = document.querySelector(".anom-slider .next");

  const today = new Date();
  const numMonths = 6;

  function fileExists(url) {
    return new Promise(resolve => {
      const img = new Image();
      img.onload = () => resolve(true);
      img.onerror = () => resolve(false);
      img.src = url;
    });
  }

  async function buildAvailableImages(prefix) {
    const items = [];

    for (let i = numMonths; i >= 1; i--) {
      const d = new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth() - i, 16);
      const yyyy = d.getFullYear();
      const mm = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");

      const path = `data/images/${prefix}_${yyyy}${mm}16.png`;
      const label = d.toLocaleString(undefined, { month: "short", year: "numeric" });

      const exists = await fileExists(path);
      if (exists) {
        items.push({
          src: path,
          label: label,
          year: String(yyyy)
        });
      }
    }

    return items;
  }

  const sstItems = await buildAvailableImages("sst");
  const anomItems = await buildAvailableImages("anom");

  if (sstYearLabels.length > 0 && sstItems.length > 0) {
    const firstYear = sstItems[0].year;
    const lastYear = sstItems[sstItems.length - 1].year;
    const labelText = firstYear === lastYear ? firstYear : `${firstYear}–${lastYear}`;
    sstYearLabels.forEach(el => {
      el.textContent = labelText;
    });
  }

  let sstIndex = Math.max(sstItems.length - 1, 0);
  let anomIndex = Math.max(anomItems.length - 1, 0);

  function updateSST() {
    if (!sstImgEl || sstItems.length === 0) {
      if (sstImgEl) sstImgEl.style.display = "none";
      if (sstPrevBtn) sstPrevBtn.style.display = "none";
      if (sstNextBtn) sstNextBtn.style.display = "none";
      return;
    }

    sstImgEl.style.display = "";
    sstImgEl.src = sstItems[sstIndex].src;

    if (sstPrevBtn) sstPrevBtn.style.opacity = sstIndex === 0 ? 0.5 : 1;
    if (sstNextBtn) sstNextBtn.style.opacity = sstIndex === sstItems.length - 1 ? 0.5 : 1;
  }

  function updateAnom() {
    if (!anomImgEl || anomItems.length === 0) {
      if (anomImgEl) anomImgEl.style.display = "none";
      if (anomPrevBtn) anomPrevBtn.style.display = "none";
      if (anomNextBtn) anomNextBtn.style.display = "none";
      return;
    }

    anomImgEl.style.display = "";
    anomImgEl.src = anomItems[anomIndex].src;

    if (anomPrevBtn) anomPrevBtn.style.opacity = anomIndex === 0 ? 0.5 : 1;
    if (anomNextBtn) anomNextBtn.style.opacity = anomIndex === anomItems.length - 1 ? 0.5 : 1;
  }

  if (sstPrevBtn && sstNextBtn) {
    sstPrevBtn.addEventListener("click", e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (sstIndex > 0) sstIndex--;
      updateSST();
    });

    sstNextBtn.addEventListener("click", e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (sstIndex < sstItems.length - 1) sstIndex++;
      updateSST();
    });
  }

  if (anomPrevBtn && anomNextBtn) {
    anomPrevBtn.addEventListener("click", e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (anomIndex > 0) anomIndex--;
      updateAnom();
    });

    anomNextBtn.addEventListener("click", e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (anomIndex < anomItems.length - 1) anomIndex++;
      updateAnom();
    });
  }

  updateSST();
  updateAnom();

  const dateEl = document.querySelector(".status-date");
  if (dateEl && !dateEl.textContent.trim()) {
    const options = { year: "numeric", month: "long", day: "numeric" };
    dateEl.textContent = today.toLocaleDateString(undefined, options);
  }
});
</script>
